title: UBWSet: A Dataset of Ugly-But-It-Works Comments Mined from Git Histories
description: UBWSet contains 26,030 lexicon-mined source-code comment records from the Git histories of 9,584 public GitHub repositories. Each record includes textual context, repository provenance, an introduction commit, a source permalink, and temporal information. Independent human annotation of a random sample of 379 records estimates the mining precision at 92.6% (95% Wilson confidence interval: 89.5%–94.8%).
